LESSON: GENERAL ETIQUETTE

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sadachar
Topic 6.1: General Etiquette

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about General Etiquette. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the use of polite words while doing community service.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the use of polite words while doing community service.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of polite words while doing community service. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about General Etiquette.
2. Explain General Etiquette to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand General Etiquette.
4. Show that you can: appreciate the use of polite words while doing community service.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about General Etiquette. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is General Etiquette important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the use of polite words while doing community service.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
